places.name: Stray Dog
places.description: All-day cafe by day, pan-Asian cocktail bar by night, in the former Junior space. Beverage menu leans on pandan and ube flavors with beans from Ritual Coffee Roasters.

places.name: Cinderella Bakery & Cafe (Mission)
places.description: Second outpost of the beloved Richmond bakery known for rye bread and Russian honey cake, finally opening after years of delays.

places.name: Saam
places.description: Debut US restaurant from Michelin-starred Bangkok chef Thitid "Ton" Tassanakajohn (Le Du, Nusara).

places.name: Oklava Cafe
places.description: Newest tenant of the Saluhall food hall in mid-Market.

places.name: Jollibee
places.description: Long-awaited Filipino fast-food chain known for fried chicken, burgers, and pies opens its doors.

places.name: Red Bay Coffee
places.description: Bay Area-based roaster celebrates its grand opening at the Ferry Building with live music and complimentary tastings of its specialty micro-roasts.

places.name: Double Black
places.description: A coffee bar inside Yardsale's flagship outdoor apparel store in Cole Valley, serving espresso drinks, matcha, and pastries.

places.name: Kaiyo Handroll Bar
places.description: A Nikkei handroll bar from the Kaiyo team pairing made-to-order handrolls with Peruvian-Japanese fusion dishes, reviving the original Kaiyo space on Union Street.

places.name: Rize Up Cafe
places.description: The first public cafe from sourdough bakery Rize Up, serving coffee, pastries, and toasts made with their colorful sourdough inside their SoMa production kitchen.

places.name: Kopê House
places.description: Barista-run cafe serving cocktail-inspired coffee drinks (red bean, black cherry, passion fruit chocolate cappuccino) alongside teas and pastries.

places.name: Le Mils Cafe
places.description: San Francisco's only cafe dedicated to Indian specialty coffee, founded to showcase beans from the owners' family farm in southern India, with pour-overs and South Indian filter coffee.

places.name: The Mess Hall
places.description: Ambitious food hall in a restored 1898 building at the Presidio's Tunnel Tops, housing three restaurant concepts (Breadwinner smashburgers, Dayboat Seafood, and Korean-inspired Boda) plus a cafe, bar, and specialty market.
